headline: Fractal Analytics Limited: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Fractal Analytics filed a Regulation 31(4) substantial acquisition of shares disclosure with the NSE, indicating a material shareholding event or takeover-related transaction requiring SEBI takeover code compliance.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosures signal either a breach of the 25% threshold triggering an open offer, or a pattern of acquisitions approaching the trigger; advisors must verify whether an open offer obligation, exemption, or prior-disclosure waiver applies.
detail: Fractal Analytics submitted a formal Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE on 16 Jun 2026. This regulation requires disclosure when a party acquires shares such that their holding reaches or exceeds 25% of paid-up capital, or makes acquisitions that would, when aggregated with prior holdings, cross the 25% threshold. The specific acquiring party, consideration, share count, timing of acquisitions, and whether an open offer has been triggered or exempted cannot be confirmed from the Bar & Bench report alone.
